The '''Jedi Temple training ground''' was an area of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] exterior, near the base of the Temple's [[Temple Spire/Legends|central spire]], where grows an ancient gnarled tree with golden boughs.

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], at around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Death Sentence 1">[[Darth Maul — Death Sentence 1|''Darth Maul — Death Sentence'' 1]]</ref> a [[Duel at the Jedi Temple/Legends|duel]] between [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] interrupted a training session of [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi younglings]] conducted by [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]] at the training ground.<ref name="TWJ" />
